title: 2024 Reunion - Style at Work Conversation: Lacey Huszcza
description:
In this talk, Richmond Symphony President and CEO, Lacy Huszcza shares her career journey that led to the business side of an orchestra. 

She talks about the "three-legged stool" of leadership running the Richmond Symphony. 

We get a unique look into how the Richmond Symphony "shapes a season," architects its unique sound, and collaborates with local businesses like Hardywood Brewery or eith other arts non-profits like the Richmond Opera.
